{'text': 'HomePod 用戶，你是否曾經想過可以關閉裝置頂部嘅觸控功能？隨住 iOS 27.2，Apple 終於加入呢個選項。以下係詳細內容。', 'paragraph_context': 'HomePod owners, have you ever wished you could disable touch controls on the top of your device? With iOS 27.2, Apple is finally adding that option. Here are the details.'}

{'text': 'HomePod 觸控功能可透過 iOS 27.2 新增嘅「鎖定控制」設定關閉', 'paragraph_context': 'HomePod touch controls can be disabled with ‘Lock Controls’ setting in iOS 27.2'}

{'text': '如果你曾經遇到 HomePod 出現幻觸問題，或者好似我一樣屋企有個細路，你可能一直希望可以關閉觸控功能。', 'paragraph_context': 'If you have ever had an issue with your HomePod and phantom touches, or perhaps like me you have a young child, you may have wished for a way to disable touch controls.'}

{'text': '據爆料者 pdfu 表示，呢個選項將會喺下星期隨 iOS 27.2 同 HomePod 27.2 正式推出。', 'paragraph_context': 'According to leaker pdfu, that option is officially coming with iOS 27.2 and HomePod 27.2 next week.'}

{'text': '如上圖所示，iOS 27.2 喺 Home App 嘅 HomePod 配件設定入面新增咗一個「鎖定控制」設定。啟用後，根據 Apple 嘅說明，功能如下：', 'paragraph_context': 'As seen in the screenshot above, iOS 27.2 adds a new setting for ‘Lock Controls’ inside the Home app’s HomePod accessory settings. When enabled, here’s what it does per Apple:'}

{'text': '防止 HomePod 喺頂部被觸碰時播放音訊或執行操作。對講機、計時器、鬧鐘、Check In 同 FaceTime 通話仍會響應觸控操作。', 'paragraph_context': 'Prevent HomePod from playing audio or taking action when the top cap is touched. Intercom, timers, alarms, Check In and FaceTime calls will still respond to touch.'}

{'text': '如果你主要透過 iPhone 或其他裝置控制 HomePod，「鎖定控制」係一個好有用嘅選項。特別係屋企有幼童或者貓，或者你嘅 HomePod 不時出現幻觸，你可能會想關閉觸控互動功能。', 'paragraph_context': 'If you control your HomePod primarily through your iPhone or another device, Lock Controls is a great option to have. Particularly if you have toddlers or cats at home, or if your HomePod experiences phantom taps, you might want to disable touch interactions.'}

{'text': '正如 pdfu 今日嘅帖文所講，呢個新設定將會支援所有 HomePod 型號，包括 2018 年推出嘅初代 HomePod。', 'paragraph_context': 'As pdfu’s post today says, this new setting is coming to all HomePod models, even the first-gen HomePod from 2018.'}

{'text': '你打算喺 iOS 27.2 使用呢個新嘅 HomePod 設定嗎？歡迎留言分享。', 'paragraph_context': 'Do you plan to use this new HomePod setting in iOS 27.2? Let us know in the comments.'}
